description: Take a published site DOWN immediately (delete it). Pass the manage token you got when you published. Use this to remove a site the moment it is no longer needed - or RIGHT AWAY if you accidentally published a secret (sites are public). Without this, a site only auto-expires ~72h after its last publish. Returns structuredContent { status:"deleted", url, deleted:true }. (A site that was CLAIMED into an account is a real CloudSite - delete it from the GearHost dashboard, not here.)

token.description: The manage token returned when the site was published.

name: unpublish_website
title: Unpublish website
